title: An Inn for Travelling Performers
paras: Beside a [[waterfall|waterfall]] in the mountain village of Bellara stands an inn with a painted red door. A century ago, it offered cheap [[accommodation|accommodation]] to travelling performers. Today, visitors come to explore its small museum and spend a night in rooms named after its former guests.

My guide, Mina, pushed a wooden [[trolley|trolley]] into the kitchen, carrying bread and jars of [[blueberry|blueberry]] jam. Over breakfast, she showed me an old photograph of a [[clown|clown]] wearing enormous shoes. His name was Pavel, and he stayed here during the winter of 1923, when heavy snow closed the mountain road.

Pavel had little money, but the owner let him stay. To repay her [[kindness|kindness]], he repaired chairs and entertained her children. Another guest taught him to [[knit|knit]], and the museum displays a pair of uneven socks beside his photograph. Its real [[treasure|treasure]], however, is a silver cup decorated with tiny birds. Pavel sent it to the owner after finding success in a distant city.

I had planned to [[rush|rush]] through the museum before lunch. Instead, I stayed to read Pavel's letters, which Mina keeps under glass. I did not [[regret|regret]] missing my planned walk. That evening, the sound of falling water filled my room, just as it had filled his a hundred years earlier.
zh: 在山村贝拉拉的一处瀑布旁，坐落着一家漆着红色大门的客栈。一百年前，这里为四处巡演的艺人提供廉价住宿。如今，游客来这里参观小小的博物馆，并在以昔日住客命名的房间里住上一晚。
我的向导米娜推着一辆木制手推车走进厨房，车上放着面包和几罐蓝莓果酱。吃早餐时，她给我看了一张老照片，照片上是一位穿着特大号鞋子的小丑。他叫帕维尔。1923年冬天，大雪封住了山路，他便住在这里。
帕维尔没什么钱，但店主仍让他留下。为了报答她的善意，他修理椅子，还逗她的孩子们开心。另一位客人教他针织，博物馆就在他的照片旁展出了一双织得不太平整的袜子。不过，馆里真正的珍宝是一只装饰着小鸟图案的银杯。帕维尔在远方的一座城市取得成功后，把它寄给了店主。
我原本打算在午饭前匆匆参观完博物馆，却留下来阅读米娜保存在玻璃下面的帕维尔的信件。没能按计划去散步，我并不后悔。那天晚上，瀑布的水声充满了我的房间，正如一百年前充满他的房间一样。

q.s: The inn no longer offers rooms for overnight stays.
q.why: 首段说游客如今仍可在客房过夜。

q.s: Pavel sent the owner a silver cup after becoming successful in a distant city.
q.why: 原文明确说他在远方城市成功后寄来银杯。

q.s: Mina has published a book containing Pavel's letters.
q.why: 只提到信件保存在玻璃下，未提出版。
